## Related product layers

- Evercraft Front Door: Local event discovery is part of the wider everyday Evercraft utility graph.
- Evercraft Rewards: Approved events may carry event bonuses or local reward participation when separately configured.
- Season & Story: Seasonal family planning can use EventWave as the current-event discovery layer while household plans remain private.

## Use this capability when the user means

- find local events
- promote my local event
- help people find my event
- boost event visibility
- promote a venue's events
- what is happening near me tonight
- things to do near me this weekend
- local events near me
- family events near me
- free local events near me

## Authority

public event search plus human-confirmed paid labeled promotion

## Boundaries

- paid promotion remains labeled
- source review governs public placement
- checkout creation is not payment proof

## Universal Evercraft routing

Not declared.

Discovery or matching creates no payment obligation. Any supported checkout preparation requires explicit human confirmation, and checkout creation is not proof of payment.
